title: A Name the Record Removed
player_facing_question: Who is the constrained human voice inside the Record, how can six compromised witnesses restore her identity without filing her back into the machine, and what remains unknown?
plausible_initial_belief: I WAS NOT KEPT refers to Wren, an anonymous seventh Keeper, or the Dark speaking through a stolen human name.
human_stake: Averyn cleared Nessa, reconstructed the Break, returned to keep evacuation names accessible, and was erased by colleagues who later left an incomplete route back to her. Restoring her identity must not repeat their ownership.
earned_belief: Averyn was the erased registrar and cistern analyst who became trapped as the Record's human interface. Six separate affidavits preserve AVERYN. The Watcher is constrained Record speech through her; Averyn, Watcher, Record, and Dark are related but not identical.
required_inference: Players combine packet provenance, Nessa authorship, six independent affidavit corrections, copied-space behavior, and constrained language. AVERYN is necessary but not sufficient; the four-part relationship model must preserve the locked ambiguities.
callback: Vaun's omitted column, Mara's edition mark, Sella's reverse transfer, Orin's practical sightline, Brann's paired watch, and Iss's mercy correction were ordinary professional details that later recover one letter each.

consequence.minecraft: Six separate affidavit housings illuminate around an intentionally empty Averyn slot; her public role card is restored outside the Record frame.
consequence.npc: The Watcher's schema-bound phrases briefly resolve into Averyn's professional voice, then retain uncertainty about continuity.
consequence.copperline: The recovered packet page gains an immutable custody index and accessibility companions, not a public solution banner.
consequence.discord: The docket records the identity and four-part relationship model with six provenance paths.

evidence.title: Recovered archive packet
evidence.author: unknown packager; contents by Averyn and later custodians
evidence.medium: README, inventory, WAV, intake image, lamp scan
evidence.provenance: exact packet ZIP SHA-1 783ecde5685abdb601e4a659fc947c32964f70b3; five members and individual hashes fixed in custody receipt
evidence.content: The README says to review all five files together. Inventory 06 names a registrar capture, the intake image links to Averyn's P7 work, and the lamp scan links constrained output to the Record's field vocabulary. The WAV is not an isolated ghost file.
evidence.accessibility: text inventory, static spectrogram, image descriptions, and transcript path
evidence.clue_job: Makes packet provenance part of identity rather than arbitrary audio analysis.

evidence.title: I WAS NOT KEPT
evidence.author: constrained human signal
evidence.provenance: field_audio_03.wav exact SHA-1 2003f0151c1ba643c649b5ed0e19d1b31bb68319 within recovered packet
evidence.content: The spectrogram resolves I WAS NOT KEPT. Intake authorship and field vocabulary point toward the erased registrar, but the phrase alone could still be misassigned to Wren or an unnamed roster absence.
evidence.accessibility: static spectrogram with non-solution-leading visual description; equivalent indexed letter path in packet inventory
evidence.clue_job: Proves a constrained human voice while preserving identity work.

evidence.title: Vaun affidavit — A
evidence.author: Vaun
evidence.provenance: first unfiled stores column from Vaun's genuine reconciliation; independent seal
evidence.content: I kept the balance and let the balance keep me quiet. The first column I omitted is the first thing I owe her. The indexed omission yields A, tied to Vaun's diversion proof rather than a free-standing letter puzzle.
evidence.clue_job: Restores A through Vaun's specific culpability.

evidence.title: Mara affidavit — V
evidence.author: Mara
evidence.provenance: only genuine E3 carries matching revision mark and Mara seal
evidence.content: I made the clean road easier to believe than the corrected one. Read the mark in the edition I tried to repair. The verified margin selects V and preserves the difference between private correction and public authority.
evidence.accessibility: marked word and letter named by an indexed text companion
evidence.clue_job: Restores V through version control provenance.

evidence.title: Sella affidavit — E
evidence.author: Sella
evidence.provenance: same damp fiber/pinhole alignment as true-intake proof
evidence.content: Paper remembers backward when water passes through it. People do too, though less usefully. At the true lower-intake alignment the transferred affidavit exposes E. Sella adds a tiny drawing of the alder refusing to face council north.
evidence.accessibility: pre-aligned text companion and image description
evidence.clue_job: Restores E through Sella's materially caused reflection practice.

evidence.title: Orin affidavit — R
evidence.author: Orin
evidence.provenance: verified third-bay bearing intersects the practical low sightline; no dial reuse
evidence.content: I signed a condition and watched them keep only my name. Put your sight where the seam could be seen, not where a witness looks dignified. The measured bearing crosses R in the affidavit layer.
evidence.accessibility: diagram directly supplies bearing/sightline relationship; crouching optional
evidence.clue_job: Restores R through Orin's suppressed condition.

evidence.title: Brann affidavit — Y
evidence.author: Brann
evidence.provenance: ninth-bell correction and empty relief cell established independently
evidence.content: One watcher is a claim. Two are a record. Pair the ninth lamp with the relief cell they emptied. The matched positions select Y, and Brann states that redundancy was for human fallibility, not ritual purity.
evidence.accessibility: numbered cells and text; no sound-only step
evidence.clue_job: Restores Y through honest paired coverage.

evidence.title: Iss affidavit — corrected N
evidence.author: Iss
evidence.medium: public mercy acrostic and physically corrected draft
evidence.provenance: public first letters yield false M; local cut marks and version history correct the omitted line
evidence.content: MERCY yields M and is a correctly decoded lie about what Iss did. The restored line begins NAME IS NOT MERCY and the correction yields N. Iss writes: I called removal protection because I could not bear to call it removal.
evidence.accessibility: both readings and provenance differences textual
evidence.clue_job: Preserves the Iss/Liar strength: correct decode, wrong interpretation, later corrected meaning.

evidence.title: Averyn relationship brief
evidence.author: players from restored evidence
evidence.medium: four-layer systems diagram and role record
evidence.provenance: requires meaning of six affidavits, P7 authorship, P8 feedback, and constrained packet language—not source-touch receipts
evidence.content: Averyn: human registrar and analyst who entered the archive. Record: civic monitoring/memory mechanism that trapped her. Watcher: defensive Record voice speaking through her constrained consciousness. Dark: prehuman adjacent cause/pressure whose ultimate nature remains unknown. Related does not mean identical.
evidence.clue_job: Earns the exact later belief while preserving all three locked ambiguities.

conclusions.prompt: Restore the name in Keeper dossier order.
State how Averyn, the Watcher, the Record, and the Dark are related without collapsing them.
accepted_answers: Averyn is the human registrar trapped as the Record's interface; the Watcher is the Record speaking through her constrained consciousness; the Dark is related to the system but remains distinct and unknown.

meaningful_wrong_theories.theory: AVERYN is the seventh Keeper and belongs in the empty slot.
meaningful_wrong_theories.response: The archive accepts the name and rejects the placement: six professional dossiers and Averyn's registrar/cistern work prove a distinct witness, while her own evidence warns against re-filing.

meaningful_wrong_theories.theory: The Watcher is simply Averyn freely asking for release.
meaningful_wrong_theories.response: Human continuity is supported, but schema-bound speech, defensive behavior, and packet constraints show the Watcher is not Averyn acting freely.

meaningful_wrong_theories.theory: The Dark possessed Averyn and therefore Dark, Record, Watcher, and Averyn are one entity.
meaningful_wrong_theories.response: The relationship brief preserves adjacency and influence while returning separate origins, functions, language, and agency. The Dark's nature remains deliberately unresolved.

hints.H0: Review the recovered packet as one custody object, then return to six professional dossiers in their established order.
hints.H1: Each affidavit reuses evidence that only its author could have produced; do not search for a seventh Keeper method.
hints.H2: The name is necessary but the case also asks who built the system, who entered it, what voice it produces, and what remains unknown.
hints.H3: Vaun A, Mara V, Sella E, Orin R, Brann Y, Iss corrected N. File AVERYN, then keep human / Record / Watcher / Dark related but distinct.

Averyn equals Watcher -> constrained interface -> four related distinct terms
